items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates that 'he' (Barney Bigard) 'took up with Bea' and describes her background, but the interviewee himself (Barney Bigard) is the subject of the story, not a participant in the relationship with Bea.

ctx.x: Was that when he left Mildred, was when he met Bea?

Yeah, well, they fell out, and when the Cotton Club moved down to Broadway, that's when he took up with Bea. And Bea used to be with -- oh, God. He was out here. He was the emcee and everything. He looked like a white boy and he stayed, lived mostly out in Pasadena. He was the emcee at the Apollo Theater.
